description: coral-agents/buyer-agent/src/llm_buyer.ts (class LLMBuyerStrategy, hardwired to `new Anthropic()`, no ClawRouter/LLM_PROVIDER support at all) is dead code with respect to the actual submitted CoralOS market flow: coral-agents/buyer-agent/src/index.ts's real market loop uses pickWinner() (index.ts lines 53-71), which calls the provider-agnostic complete() from @pay/agent-runtime, NOT LLMBuyerStrategy. llm_buyer.ts is referenced only by its own file and by buyer.test.ts's import of the unrelated parse402 helper (confirmed via grep: no other reference to LLMBuyerStrategy anywhere in the repo). Its docstring ('the agent-economy primitive... Claude, given a goal, fetches a paid endpoint...') and un-updated Anthropic-only implementation is left in the fork with no comment marking it as legacy/unused for THIS submission's actual flow, creating a real risk that a judge reading the codebase (not just running the demo command) concludes the buyer's core decision loop is Anthropic-hardwired and therefore NOT zero-human-key -- directly undermining the submission's central differentiation claim.
